definitionName: Nightwatch release certification — ordered advance conditions (F-12)
note: The certification record for nightwatch.project-state.v2. Each condition names the check whose output decides it; a condition with no registered check fails the definition itself (bin/project-state-check.mjs + src/core/releaseCertification/index.ts). evidenceSha binds the commit at which the condition's evidence was earned: a SHA strictly preceding the certified checkpoint reports STALE_EVIDENCE, does not count as met, and refuses the certification. The production path (C-12 → C-14, P4) is deliberately NOT a condition; it is reported as a separate external track.

nextStatus.statement: No status beyond OPERATIONALLY_ACCEPTED is named until the owner names one. The safe default, and the only status this programme asserts, remains OPERATIONALLY_ACCEPTED.

externalTrack.statement: C-12 → C-14 and P4 are externally gated (C-08b mochi access, observer identity). They are reported with their own status and are never counted among the advance conditions.

conditions.title: every declared validation lane resolves PROVEN, or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL / UNAVAILABLE_CAPABILITY with a current unexpired record naming its owner action
exact-head CI is executed or its block record is current and complete
conditions.evidence: project-state block CI_OBSERVED_SHA / CI_EXECUTED_SHA / CI_STATUS plus the exact-checkpoint-ci lane record

conditions.title: the autonomous yield campaign has completed with per-case reasons recorded, whatever its yield
the change ledger and the spec baseline agree with task truth
conditions.evidence: bin/agent-state.mjs ledger diagnostics (LEDGER_TERMINAL_TASK_HAS_OPEN_ITEMS and the agent-audit totals)

conditions.title: the CLI contract sweep passes over every entry point
conditions.evidence: bin/lib/operator-command-listing.mjs static listing (the sweep suite's own inputs)

conditions.title: the document-role and status-ledger checks pass
no workspace claim names a terminal task and no legacy record is undisposed
conditions.evidence: bin/agent-state.mjs CLAIM_TASK_* diagnostics and legacy_undeclared total

conditions.title: the dependency assessment is executed or currently recorded unavailable
no tracked source module is unreferenced outside a reasoned retention list, and no module barrier is both unimported and unremoved
every dynamic module path and every symbol read from one resolves statically, bin/** type-checks, and every entry point has an executing test
conditions.evidence: config/bin-typecheck.v1.json mode plus the loader contract audit in bin/lib/cli-implementation-contract.mjs

conditions.title: every structural rule is comment-proof where positive, occurrence-complete where total, and has a detected mutation probe
every schema identifier is declared persisted or in-memory, and no persisted version change lacks a disposition
every member of ApiErrorKind renders distinguishably and the failure path is covered by the render harness
every environment variable the code reads is declared and validated, and every environment file is schema-validated
no status distinction is colour-only, every rendered contrast pair meets its ratio, and every operator workflow completes by keyboard
every authenticated lane pre-flights its artefact and refuses an expired, wrong-environment or unknown-age one before any effect
